pictures.name: city_walls_at_first_light
pictures.scene: the walls and towers of a hill city taking the first light of the day, the lower ramparts lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the upper walls and the sky above them pale and clear and quiet

pictures.name: heavy_bar_across_the_gate
pictures.scene: a great squared timber bar dropped firmly into its iron sockets across a shut gate, the bar and the sockets lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the gate boards above it dark and plain

pictures.name: courtyard_full_of_growing_things
pictures.scene: a sheltered courtyard crowded with young trees and herbs in pots and beds, the nearest green leaves lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the walls above them dim and rough and quiet

pictures.name: wheat_poured_from_a_measure
pictures.scene: clean golden wheat pouring in a steady stream from a wooden measure into a full basket, the falling grain lit warm and bright low in the frame, the store room above and behind it brown and dim

pictures.name: wind_running_across_a_grain_field
pictures.scene: a long visible gust running fast across a field of standing grain and bending it in one wave, the near ears lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the field beyond going pale and soft and open

pictures.name: fresh_snow_over_the_hills
pictures.scene: a soft unbroken fall of new snow lying over a range of low hills, the nearest drift lit warm and faintly gold at the bottom of the frame, the white slopes and sky above it pale and even and silent

pictures.name: hailstones_on_frozen_ground
pictures.scene: a scatter of hard white hailstones lying on dark frozen ground, the nearest stones lit hard and bright at the bottom of the frame, the cold bare earth beyond them running away dull and grey and flat

pictures.name: thaw_beginning_on_the_slope
pictures.scene: snow softening and drawing back on a hillside with dark wet grass showing through it, the melting edge lit warm and bright low in the frame, the white slope above it going soft and pale and quiet

pictures.name: meltwater_running_in_the_gully
pictures.scene: bright meltwater running fast and full down a stony mountain gully, the moving water lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the rock walls above it dim and wet and standing close

pictures.name: smoothed_stone_slab
pictures.scene: a broad slab of pale stone dressed perfectly flat and smooth and standing upright and quite bare, its lower edge lit warm and hard, the plain surface above it even and dim and free of any mark at all

pictures.name: single_lit_valley_among_dark_hills
pictures.scene: one narrow valley filled with clear sunlight while the hills on every side of it stay in deep shade, the lit floor warm and gold low in the frame, the dark ridges above it heavy and blue and still

pictures.name: dark_hills_without_a_light
pictures.scene: a long range of hills lying under a heavy dusk with not one light showing anywhere upon them, the near scrub lit faintly at the bottom of the frame, the slopes and sky above them dim and cold and blank

pictures.name: sun_breaking_wide_over_the_land
pictures.scene: the sun breaking clear over a wide open country and flooding it all with light, the near fields lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the far hills and the sky above them bright and immense

lines.text: For He strengthens the bars of your gates
and blesses the children within you.
He makes peace at your borders;
He fills you with the finest wheat.
He sends forth His command to the earth;
He spreads the snow like wool;
He scatters the frost like ashes;
He casts forth His hail like pebbles.
Who can withstand His icy blast?
He sends forth His word and melts them;
He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
He declares His word to Jacob,
His statutes and judgments to Israel.
He has done this for no other nation;
they do not know His judgments.
